info.title: DukaPay API
info.description: Backend API for DukaPay lending, scoring, remittance, and indexer flows.

message.example:
Sign this message to authenticate with DukaPay.

Timestamp: 1700000000000

This request will expire in 5 minutes.

post.description: Submits the authenticated user's identity details to the configured screening provider and returns the screening outcome (`approved`, `review`, or `rejected`) with the provider reference.

post.description: Blacklists the current token's jti so it is rejected by requireJwtAuth even though it has not yet expired, and clears the auth cookie.

get.summary: SSE stream for real-time loan events
get.description: Server-Sent Events endpoint for real-time loan event push. Auth MUST be provided via the Authorization: Bearer <token> header. Borrowers receive only their own events; optional `?borrower=G...` must match the authenticated wallet. Admin users receive all events when borrower is omitted. Supports replay on reconnect via `Last-Event-ID` header. Since native EventSource does not support custom headers, clients should use fetch with ReadableStream to connect.

parameters.name: borrower
parameters.description: Borrower's Stellar address. When provided, only events for this borrower are streamed (JWT must match). When omitted, all events are streamed (admin JWT required).

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: The ID of the last processed SSE event; server replays newer events on reconnect.

get.description: Returns current SSE connection statistics. Requires an `admin:indexer` scoped API key.
Returns the current state of the event indexer including last indexed ledger and event counts

get.summary: Get events for a specific borrower
get.description: Returns loan events for the authenticated wallet; `borrower` must match the JWT Stellar public key.

403.description: borrower does not match authenticated wallet

get.summary: Get events for a specific loan
get.description: Returns events only if the authenticated wallet is the borrower for that loan.

404.description: Loan not found or not accessible

get.description: Internal/admin use: requires an `admin:indexer` scoped `x-api-key`. Returns the most recent loan events, optionally filtered by event type.

Returns the current underwriting configuration used when pricing and approving loans: the minimum credit score required, maximum principal, annual interest rate, and the credit score threshold. Read-only and public.

post.description: Computes the amortization schedule (principal/interest split and due dates) for a prospective loan without persisting anything. Useful before the borrower confirms a loan request.
Allows a borrower to contest a defaulted loan, moving it to disputed status and logging the dispute.

get.summary: Get loans for a specific borrower

parameters.name: from

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO-8601 end of approved_at date range (inclusive)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response for pagination

get.description: Returns the computed amortization schedule for an approved loan of the authenticated borrower. Mirrors the shape produced by `/loans/amortization-preview` and includes the loan id.

get.summary: Get events for a specific loan

403.description: Loan belongs to a different borrower

403.description: Loan belongs to a different borrower

post.description: Builds an unsigned Soroban `refinance_loan(loan_id, new_amount, new_term)` transaction XDR. Both the admin and borrower must sign.

403.description: Loan belongs to a different borrower

borrowerPublicKey.description: Borrower's Stellar public key (must match JWT)

Returns high-level lending-pool analytics: total deposits and withdrawals, yield distributed, loans issued, total volume and the number of active agents. Public endpoint; cached for 300 seconds.

parameters.description: Stellar public key of the agent

get.summary: Get depositor portfolio for a wallet address
get.description: Returns deposit amount, pool share percentage, and estimated yield for the authenticated depositor. `address` must match the JWT wallet.

403.description: address does not match authenticated wallet

get.description: Returns a bounded time series of deposited value, current share value, and net yield for the authenticated depositor. Supports `days` query param (7, 30, or 90).

403.description: address does not match authenticated wallet

get.summary: Get current on-chain share price for a pool token
get.description: Returns the current share price from the LendingPool contract. The value is scaled by 1,000,000 (e.g. 1,050,000 = 1.05 ratio). Cached briefly to absorb burst requests.

post.description: Builds an unsigned Soroban `deposit(provider, token, amount)` transaction XDR against the LendingPool contract. The frontend signs it with the user's wallet and submits via POST /api/pool/submit.

depositorPublicKey.description: Depositor's Stellar public key (must match JWT)

token.description: Address of the token to deposit

post.description: Builds an unsigned Soroban `withdraw(provider, token, shares)` transaction XDR against the LendingPool contract. The frontend signs it with the user's wallet and submits via POST /api/pool/submit.

depositorPublicKey.description: Depositor's Stellar public key (must match JWT)

token.description: Address of the token to withdraw

post.summary: Build an unsigned emergency withdraw transaction
post.description: Builds an unsigned Soroban `emergency_withdraw(provider, token, shares)` transaction XDR against the LendingPool contract. Bypasses the withdrawal cooldown. The frontend signs it with the user's wallet and submits via POST /api/pool/submit.

depositorPublicKey.description: Depositor's Stellar public key (must match JWT)

token.description: Address of the token to withdraw

post.description: Submits a signed transaction XDR to the Stellar network for a pool deposit or withdrawal.

post.summary: Request a copy of your data (DSAR - Data Subject Access Request)
post.description:
GDPR Art. 15 / CCPA right-to-know. Creates a DSAR access request.
The platform will prepare an export of all your data within 30 days.

post.summary: Request deletion of your data (Right to be Forgotten)
post.description:
GDPR Art. 17 / CCPA right-to-delete. Removes PII while preserving
anonymized financial records for accounting compliance.

Replaces PII with consistent hashes while preserving behavioral
patterns for aggregate analytics.

Returns all data associated with the given public key in JSON format.
Includes profile, scores, loan events, remittances, and audit logs.

parameters.name: q

get.description: Returns the top 50 credit scores ordered descending. Public endpoint; cached for 60 seconds. Each entry contains the wallet address, its current score, and the corresponding band.
Returns the current credit score for the authenticated wallet only: `userId` must match the Stellar public key in the JWT.

403.description: userId does not match the authenticated wallet.

get.summary: Retrieve a user's on-chain credit score history
get.description: Queries the RemittanceNFT contract for the score history vector and returns a chronologically sorted timeline. Cached for 60 seconds to avoid spamming the Soroban RPC.

403.description: walletAddress does not match the authenticated wallet.

get.summary: Retrieve a wallet's on-chain credit score NFT metadata
get.description: Queries the RemittanceNFT contract and returns the on-chain metadata backing a wallet's credit score NFT: the current score, a history digest hash, metadata URI, default counter, transfer cooldown and the ledger of the last update. `walletAddress` must match the JWT wallet. Returns `null` for the `nft` field when no NFT exists.

transferCooldownRemaining.description: Remaining cooldown in seconds before the NFT can be transferred.

403.description: walletAddress does not match the authenticated wallet.

get.summary: Get a detailed credit score breakdown
get.description: Returns the user's credit score along with a detailed breakdown of contributing factors (repayment history, streaks, defaults) and a score history timeline. Derived from loan_events and scores tables. `userId` must match the Stellar public key in the JWT.

403.description: userId does not match the authenticated wallet.

post.summary: Update a user's credit score based on repayment history
post.description: Adjusts the user's credit score by +15 for on-time repayments or −30 for late payments. Requires an `admin:loans` scoped API key or a legacy internal API key.

401.description: Unauthorised — missing or invalid API key.

get.summary: Get remittance history for a user
get.description: Retrieve the remittance history for the authenticated user. The userId path parameter must match the JWT wallet.

403.description: Authenticated wallet does not match userId.

404.description: User not found or no remittance history available.

post.description: Simulate a remittance payment for the authenticated user and return the projected score change.

Pre-execution validation: dry-runs a Soroban contract call, returns gas
estimation, predicted return value, failure reason (if any), and warnings.
Simulations are cached for 30 seconds.

contractId.description: Stellar contract address to simulate against

sourceAccount.description: Account to simulate from (must be a valid Stellar public key)

200.description: Simulation result with gas estimate and return value

get.description: Returns a paginated list of transactions for the authenticated wallet, including the type, amount, currency, counterparty and on-chain status (or `null` when not yet submitted).

200.description: User profile returned, creating an empty profile on first access.
